comments.author: Chronic
comments.body:
How do you figure? If you grade properly even a G3 non astro ship is very good, even better than lesser grades astro ships. If you go to g3 on a battleship youll have 40 dura/4 armor just from the bonus' plus most "lvl 75 ships" are official built already starting them with 60-80 dura, right there your already 120 dura... Now if you choose the dura bonus as one of the major upgs youll have max dura covered at a 1/4 ship plus whatever skill u add from FS building the ship and the 4 armor from fusion bonus. Leaves you atleast 3 mods and 1 major fusion upgrade left to add anything else u please since max dura and 1 optional skill would be done already...
Its very easy to make non astro ships very usable.

comments.author: DiNozzo

comments.author: MarcoS
comments.body:
don't rebuild normal/FS ships for fusing or whatever reason, dismantling FS battle ships is a criminal act! otherwise you lose the +dura etc given from the hull FS part. and i totally agree with Chronic, FS ships are great, SOTS for example, more dura, armour, crew, speed in battle than a FFCV, limited to only 4 mods which fusing opens up alot of choices. id rather have a g3 4/4 SOTS than a g3 7/7 FFCV.
La couronne is so nice to use too, very fast in and out of battle, good skills, crew, ok dura/armour.
Neapolitan galleass is fast, highest crew of a FS built ship (atleast for now) with 273 crew and good skills.
